about: The EngineView the gateway answers GET /admin/engines with (services/gateway/app/engines.py, S40), field by field and in order. services/gateway/tests/test_engines.py pins the dataclass to this file; core's machines reader (T5 engine_view, T7 as_row) and the web Machine type read these names. A field renamed on one side without this file moving is a red test, never a silent None on the other.
